candidates.description: This vector represents the concept of importance, significance, and relevance across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents abstract human constructs, social systems, and collective beliefs.
This feature activates for words related to causing an effect, impact, or change, along with morphological variants of "influence."
This vector represents concepts of cultural heritage, historical continuity, and the contrast between traditional and modern practices.
This feature vector represents the concept of scale, magnitude, or degree of intensity.
This vector represents concepts related to major world religions, particularly Christianity and Islam, along with their associated practitioners, places of worship, and spiritual leaders.
This vector is related to academic suffixes, root words, and terminology associated with specific fields of study.
This feature vector represents adverbial intensifiers and degree modifiers across multiple languages.
These tokens represent common nominal and adverbial suffixes found across Romance and Germanic languages.
This vector represents subordinating conjunctions and adverbial connectors across multiple European languages.
